independence: Researcher-authored control expectations are evaluator-only and absent from model context. Same-agent labels are not independent adjudication. No held-out quality claim.
remainingProtocol: Before paid quality evaluation register twelve distinct researcher/user tasks (six development, six held-out), independently inspect decisive source references, freeze task/rubric hashes and select stochastic repeats. Current controls do not satisfy this dataset requirement.

metrics.local: Outcome, exact source/version/locator/support trace, observed wall time, model/extraction calls, recorded synthetic receipt and unknown-hold fields, correction identity reuse
metrics.semantic: Support precision, material coverage, independent constraint correctness, decisive-evidence use, contradiction handling and actual user repair stay null until adjudicated.

spend: No paid requests authorized. Local harness replaces provider transport explicitly and never interprets synthetic receipts as actual provider expenditure.
failures: Record attempted arm outcomes and unexpected failures before propagating test failure; never exclude a losing arm or silently retry. Do not assert superiority from local transport controls.
